content:
Sam: quick thread — I pushed a fresh draft for the three landing flows into the Figma board: https://figma.com/file/placeholder
Sam: goal = crisp hero + 1-line product value + single primary CTA per page. want feedback before copy freeze.
Maya: catching up now. can you paste hero variants here? trying to align with the webinar launch cadence. :calendar:
Sam: dropping roughs — feel free to rewrite tone:
Sam: Hosted A: 'Hosted inference for production LLMs, no infra overhead.'
Sam: Hosted B: 'Production-ready LLMs, served as an API.'
Sam: Dedicated A: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput.'
Sam: Dedicated B: 'Dedicated pools, consistent latency.'
Sam: Private A: 'Private deployment with enterprise controls & audit logs.'
Sam: Private B: 'On-prem & VPC options for regulated workloads.'
Elena: design note — Private hero needs to be shorter to fit above the fold. prefer: 'Private inference. Enterprise controls.'
Raj: product ask — avoid jargon like "infra overhead". keep customer-focused outcome. Suggested edits:
Raj: Hosted: 'Hosted inference that scales with your app.'
Raj: Dedicated: 'Guaranteed throughput for critical apps.'
Raj: Private: 'Data-isolated deployment for compliance.'
Jordan: growth notes — inbound routing plan: Hosted -> signup/self-serve funnel; Dedicated -> contact-sales with SLA checkbox; Private -> book a demo + security packet download. Need UTM/tagging rules.
Sam: routing snippet for eng/ops (will add to Notion):
Sam: ```
/landing/hosted -> form:signup, tag:hosted_trial, utm_source=website
/landing/dedicated -> form:contact_sales, tag:reserved_inquiry, lead_tier=enterprise
/landing/private -> book_demo, tag=private_request, attach=security_packet
```
Maya: love the routing. also propose an alternate Hosted hero for A/B test: 'Low-latency inference for product teams.' split-test 50/50 for 2 weeks.
Sam: noted. I'll add A/B test setup to the doc.
Elena: microcopy — small badge under price area: 'Pay-as-you-go or reserved discounts available.' keeps it short.
Raj: one more product constraint — can't promise 'zero setup' for Dedicated/Private; reword to 'minimal setup' for Hosted only.
Sam: good catch. will update language.
Jordan: for the webinar landing, we should reuse Hosted hero line but add 'Join the webinar' CTA and prefill question box for registrants. also add a benchmark snapshot: '<2x latency vs baseline' — legal will need exact numbers.
Sam: i'll draft benchmark copy but will flag legal.
DevBot: reminder: marketing content freeze for landing pages scheduled 2026-04-03T17:00:00-07:00
Maya: timeline check — can design mock by EOD Thurs? Elena?
Elena: yes, mock + mobile stack by Thu EOD.
Sam: i'll update Notion with final routing and copy variants and ping legal + sales. https://notion.so/redwood/landing-routing (placeholder)
Raj: tagging taxonomy to include: source=website, page=(hosted|dedicated|private), intent=(signup|sales|demo), ga_campaign=landing_copy_surgery
Sam: thanks everyone — will consolidate into a single doc and post final before freeze. @Maya @Elena @Jordan
